instructions_to_main_agent: Implement 'Dark Mode' as the DEFAULT and PRIMARY theme. Do not rely on system preference; force dark theme for public pages.
Use the 'Outfit' font for all headings. You must import it from Google Fonts in index.css.
Use 'DM Sans' for all body text. Import from Google Fonts.
The Navbar must be floating and glassmorphic, not attached to the top edge.
Hero sections must use full-screen background images with the specified gradients.
Product cards must use the 'Tracing Beam' or subtle border glow effect on hover.
Forms must use the custom input style defined above (transparent bg + white border), do not use default white inputs.
All interactive elements must have the 'data-testid' attribute.
Ensure the orange accent (#F97316) is used sparingly for impact (Buttons, active states, glows), not for large backgrounds.
For the 'About' page, create a story-driven layout with large typography and the team image.
Keep the 'Contact' page minimal with a large map and the transparent contact form.
Do not break existing Admin/Customer dashboard routes, but ensure the public pages feel distinctively premium.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are encouraged.
